sentences.wiring_vs_shuffle: On all five seeds, the fly's 166,700-neuron wiring and its degree-preserving shuffle reproduced SuperTruth's Data Trust Index engine equally well: composite error 1.74 vs 1.60 points (difference 0.14, 95% CI -0.45 to +0.17), tier agreement 0.872 vs 0.872.
sentences.wiring_vs_random_and_matched_network: A random graph at the fly's density matched the fly's wiring on tier agreement (0.869 vs 0.872) and matched it on composite error (1.78 vs 1.74 points); all three fixed graphs came closer than a same-size trained network to reproducing the DTI engine (3.71 points, 0.854).
sentences.model_arms_beside_fly: Four models given the DTI paper and 300 of the same records matched the engine's tier on 20% (Claude Opus 5) to 45% (Gemini 3 Flash), at 13 s to 73 s and $0.04 to $0.26 per record. The fly's wiring matched the engine's tier on 84% of the same 300 records, in 16 ms and at $0 marginal cost per record.
sentences.bii: On VIGIL's Behavioral Integrity Index (BII), in the reduced setting the paper describes (seed policy, empty registries), the fly's wiring reached score error 0.0272 and gate agreement 0.916 on 4,000 synthetic windows; shuffle minus fly +0.0005, 95% CI -0.00 to +0.00.
sentences.model_arms_with_examples: In a second round run after the rules were set, given the same paper plus 100 engine-scored example records, the four models matched the engine's tier on 54% (GPT-5) to 76% (Claude Opus 5) of the same 300 records; the fly's wiring, 84%.
